response.overview: After being released from prison, Booyoung tries to rebuild his life while working at a redevelopment demolition site and holding a night job to secure housing. Wanting only a quiet life, he is still shadowed by the stigma of his past. When “Murderer Baek Booyoung” appears spray-painted on a wall, his buried trauma resurfaces. Discovering that his only friend, Hyun-soo, is secretly involved with the group targeting him, Booyoung realizes his long-carried burden is tied to him. As the truth of their shared past emerges, tensions erupt, drawing the two men into a violent confrontation that reveals not just personal guilt but the deeper violence created by society.
response.title: Redevelopment
